headline: Arlene Smith, Whose Song ‘Maybe’ Helped Define Doo-Wop, Dies at 84
context: With the Chantels, a groundbreaking female vocal group, she tugged heartstrings with the indelible hit and paved the way for a wave of “girl groups.”
